item.summary: fix(gateway): leave sessions without human-derived titles untitled (#120160) deriveSessionTitle no longer falls back to an 8-hex session-id prefix plus date; derived titles are human content only, so consumers' key-based fallbacks (Control UI "New thread", TUI formatted key, ACP displayName/label/key) render instead of an opaque machine title.
